correctness.rationale: The matrix spectral dichotomy is complete, including d=1, ties, PSD boundaries and negative kernels. If a negative quadratic direction exists, far endpoints in the cell and site-star force its entire line into the cell. Indefinite null directions span the whole space, contradicting the strictly positive separating linear coefficient; negative semidefinite H forces the generating-site displacement itself to be a negative direction, contradicting its strict positive quadratic cost. Positive semidefinite H makes the cell convex. Explicit roots and exact rational obstruction are checked in standalone code; no finite experiment proves universality.
